basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III (General Medicine) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Project Nurse III post is open in the Department of General Medicine, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Jodhpur, under the project "Implementation of AMSP in various tertiary care centres across India", funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The post is purely temporary, with tenure as per project requirement and monthly salary as per ICMR norms. The essential qualification is a four-year B.Sc. Nursing course, and candidates send their CV with the filled application form to [email protected] by 16 November 2026 before 5:00 PM.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed to shortlisted/selected candidates

how_to_apply: Fill the "Format for Application" printed with the notice (page 3). It asks for the name of the post, Advertisement File No. and date, name, father's name, date of birth, age, permanent and correspondence addresses, email, phone numbers, qualifications from High School onwards and post-qualification experience, with a passport size photo and signature.
Attach all essential qualification and experience certificates with the application form. Without them the application will be considered incomplete.
Combine the CV and the duly filled application form together in one single PDF file.
Email the PDF to [email protected] by 16 November 2026 before 5:00 PM.
Applications received without the duly filled application form in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected and the candidate will be disqualified.
important_instructions: No enquiries shall be entertained after the due date. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III
content_sections.text: The Project Nurse III post is part of an Extramural Research project at AIIMS Jodhpur, run under the Principal Investigator Dr. Deepak Kumar, Additional Professor, Department of General Medicine. The project, "Implementation of AMSP in various tertiary care centres across India", is funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The project office is at the Department of General Medicine, Medicine OPD, Room No. 119, 1st Floor, B Block OPD Building, AIIMS Jodhpur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Four-year B.Sc. Nursing course from a recognized university/institute. Desirable: Experience in clinical research/AMSP/Infection Control Computer proficiency Good communication skills Age concession: Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case to case basis (only applicable for ICMR Project). Other conditions printed in the notice: All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Any experience counted should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification required for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Project Nurse III post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly salary is as per ICMR norms. The notice states that the salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits, and that it is based on the experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidate. No fixed amount is printed. The tenure is as per project requirement. The post is filled purely on a temporary basis, co-terminus with the project, and the position will be on a temporary/contractual basis for the specified period of time and based on the project. The selected candidate will have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation of services in any other project, and the contract service will not confer any right for further assignment or regular appointment in the institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III
content_sections.text: Applications received without the duly filled application form in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected and the candidate will be disqualified.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only the shortlisted/selected candidates will be called for the interview, and only they will be informed of the interview date and time. Candidates called for the interview must appear in person along with all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience. Persons working in Government or a Public Sector Undertaking must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Nurse III vacancies are there at AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: There is 01 Project Nurse III post in the Department of General Medicine under the ICMR-funded AMSP project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III post?
faq.answer: The last date for sharing the CV is 16 November 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a four-year B.Sc. Nursing course from a recognized university/institute; experience in clinical research/AMSP/Infection Control, computer proficiency and good communication skills are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III post?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 30 years, counted till the last date of the advertisement. Age concession for service in other research projects may be admissible on a case to case basis (only for ICMR Project).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is as per ICMR norms, a consolidated sum without any other benefits, based on experience, qualifications, skill set, etc.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III post?
faq.answer: Send your CV and the duly filled application form, with qualification and experience certificates, together in one single PDF file to [email protected] by 16 November 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted/selected candidates will be called for an interview, which they must attend in person with original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary, co-terminus with the project, and gives no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need an NOC for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. Persons working in Government or a Public Sector Undertaking must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
